title: Female borrowers who mention specific social or environmental benefits, such as children's education, may fund faster.
Pitches that include specific loan details, such as the lending partner and the loan amount in local currency, fund faster regardless of gender.
Male borrowers who emphasize family quality of life fund faster than those who use technical terminology.
Female borrowers who mention specific institutional or community affiliations may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers using the specific phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention previous loans from NWTF may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention using income from a husband to repay the loan may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention their education or motivations for starting their business fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention reducing health and hazard risks to the family may fund faster.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who list the specific ages of their children fund faster.
Female borrowers who use generic template language fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention a specific town or city in their pitch fund faster.
Female borrowers who include explicit gratitude or thanks to lenders fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
